Thank you so much Olu and Nadeem. Highly recommend.

reviews.comment:
This is a genuine review, straight from my heart. I was a miserable driver with zero confidence. I had already failed my first test with 3 majors and 7 minors before I approached Prime skills. (I don't want to disclose or disgrace the name of the previous instructor and the previous driving school as that is not the purpose here!) Anyway, I wanted to get trained by a different instructor who could understand my struggles and teach me the best way that would fit me in.

After researching online, I found the Prime Skills and contacted Nadeem, and spoke about my situation. I was skeptical at first whether he would consider me as he is extremely busy with learners and training other instructors. Despite his busy schedule, he was kind enough to give me a slot.

Believe you me, considering all my teachers who taught me in all walks of my life, I will definitely say that he is one of the most genuine teachers that I have ever come across in my life. He understood my problems, corrected me, motivated me, advised me like a father, conducted intensive sessions, and taught me the exact methodology of driving in the UK.

And bang, in just 5 days of training, I cleared my driving test. In just 5 days! I still can't believe it - a massive shift from where I was to where I am now.

Thank you so much, Nadeem, for the effort and the belief you had in me!

I sincerely recommend him to anyone who is reading this review. So, don't give it a second thought. Believe in him, obey him, do what he says, and I will 100% guarantee you that you will pass your test.

All the best! God bless you!
